title: Independent review verdict file ($EV/reviews/<gate-or-wp>.json)
description: Format of every [REVIEW] verdict file of tasks.md (docs/21 section 4.4 and IC-46, the plan owner's held-commit rules after the review of commit af664ed0). Producer: the reviewing stream ST-REV, never the stream that made the change (FR-023, constitution 11.4.142, 11.4.240). Consumers: the commit-push script stage S6, which releases a held commit (one whose message carries `Awaits-Review: <this file's path>`) only when this file is committed in the main repository's HEAD with verdict GO and its covers_runs lists the held commit's CPA-Run id; stage S5, which refuses a new hold on a file that already holds GO (exit 20, reason verdict_already_go); the register importer of review rows (docs/04 reg_reviews: GO or NO-GO, model and effort). covers_runs lists every commit the review read, each by repository path (`.` for the main repository, otherwise the submodule path from the main repository root), commit sha and the CPA-Run id from that commit's trailer; it may be empty when the reviewed change is not committed yet (a task that commits only after its GO), and such a verdict releases no held commit. model and effort record what actually performed the review (constitution 11.4.209: Opus at xhigh); effort `?` records that the dispatch path could not set or report it (11.4.231(F.2)), never a claimed xhigh. Validated only against synthetic fixtures (no verdict file exists yet); see contracts/README.md. Other fields a task records (findings, reviewer-authored mutations, gate-specific checks) are allowed.

gate.description: the gate or work package reviewed, for example G-GATE or WP-04

author.description: the stream that produced the reviewed change; the register importer refuses a verdict whose author equals its reviewer (docs/04 reg_reviews), a cross-field rule JSON Schema cannot express

reviewer.description: the reviewing stream or agent, never the producing stream

repository.description: `.` or a path relative to the main repository root, no leading or trailing slash

cpa_run.description: the run id of the commit's `CPA-Run:` trailer: UTC start time to the second, process id, random suffix
